14100.commentary: (VINt) samaggena pana saṅghena ukkhittaṃ bhikkhuṃ yā bhikkhunī yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti, tassā diṭṭhiyā gahaṇavasena anuvattati, sā ukkhittānuvattikā nāma

14101.meaning1: rule about taking sides with a suspended monastic

14103.meaning1: with a raised sword; with weapon drawn

examples.text: sabbasaṅkhāresu ca me nibbidasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā bhavissati, seyyathā'pi ukkhitt'āsike vadhake. sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati, nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi
puriso ca te ukkhitt'āsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati. yatth'eva naṃ thokam'pi chaḍḍessati tatth'eva te siro pātessatī'ti.
atha kho naṃ khippam'eva sannipatitvā ukkhipati. kiñ'c'āpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno, atha kho so ārakā'va saṅghamhā, saṅgho ca tena

14106.meaning1: raises up; lifts up; holds up
14106.commentary: (VINa) paṭilātaṃ ukkhipatī'ti dayhamānaṃ alātaṃ patitaṃ ukkhipati, puna yathāṭhāne ṭhapetī'ti attho.

examples.text: brāhmaṇo evam'āha, ukkhipa laṅgiṃ, abhikkhaṇa, sumedha, satthaṃ ādāyā'ti. abhikkhaṇanto sumedho satthaṃ ādāya addasa uddhumāyikaṃ. uddhumāyikā, bhadante'ti.
paṭilātaṃ ukkhipati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. gilāno agilānasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī asaṅkaccikā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. tassā rathikāya vātamaṇḍalikā saṅghāṭiyo ukkhipiṃsu. manussā ukkuṭṭhiṃ akaṃsu, sundarā ayyāya than'udarā'ti.

tattha nāgā yojanikāni chatt'ātichattāni ukkhipiṃsu. evaṃ heṭṭhā nāgā bhūmitale rukkhagacchapabbat'ādīsu bhūmaṭṭhakā devatā, antalikkhe ākāsaṭṭhadevā'ti nāgabhavanaṃ ādiṃ katvā cakkavāḷapariyantena yāva brahmalokā chatt'ātichattāni ussāpitāni ahesuṃ.

14110.meaning1: should be raised up; should be lifted up; should be held up

examples.text: cakkaratanassa hi uppattisamanantaram'eva n'atthi so satto nāma, yo paccatthikasaññāya taṃ rājānaṃ ārabbha āvudhaṃ ukkhipituṃ visaheyya

14112.meaning1: having raised up; having lifted up

examples.text: na ukkhittakāya antaraghare gantabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca ekato vā ubhato vā ukkhipitvā antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
dhātiyo ayyaputto ekako'ti vegena sāṇiṃ ukkhipitvā anto pavisamānā bodhisattaṃ sayane pallaṅkena nisinnaṃ tañ'ca pāṭihāriyaṃ disvā gantvā rañño ārocayiṃsu

14113.meaning2: is raised; is thrown up or about

14114.meaning2: is raised; is thrown up or about

examples.text: cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ. sotassa rahonāma na sakkā hoti pakatikathā sotuṃ.

14116.commentary: (VINa) ukkheṭito'ti idaṃ ariyamaggena uttāsitattā puna anallīyanabhāvadassanavasena. sv'āyam'attho saddasatthato pariyesitabbo.

14117.meaning1: fact of having frightened away; fact of having scared off
14117.construction:
ud + kheṭe + ita + tta
ukkheṭita + tta

examples.text: yaṃ mahāvātā'ti yena samayena yasmiṃ vā samaye mahāvātā vāyanti, mahāvātā vāyantā'pi ukkhepakavātā nāma uṭṭhahanti, te vāyantā saṭṭhisahass'ādhika-navayojanasatasahassabahalaṃ udakasandhārakaṃ vātaṃ upacchindanti, tato ākāse udakaṃ bhassati, tasmiṃ bhass'ante pathavī bhassati.

14126.meaning2: dealt by a legal act of suspension; suspended

14127.commentary: (PYt) āpattiadassan'ādīsu uddharitvā khipīyati apanīyati anena vinayakammenā'ti ukkhepanīyaṃ, tam'eva kammaṃ ukkhepanīyakammaṃ.

examples.text: hand'assa mayaṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karomā'ti. te tassa āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karonti

14128.commentary: (VBt) chaḍḍīyati sātisāro bhikkhusaṅghena, taṃ kammaṃ ukkhepanīyakammaṃ nāmā'ti veditabbaṃ. (PYt) āpattiadassan'ādīsu uddharitvā khipīyati apanīyati anena vinayakammenā'ti ukkhepanīyaṃ, tam'eva kammaṃ ukkhepanīyakammaṃ.

examples.text: hand'assa mayaṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karomā'ti. te tassa āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karonti

14129.commentary: (VINa) uklāpo'ti kenaci kacavarena saṅkiṇṇo, sace pana añño kacavaro n'atthi, udakaphusitān'eva honti, hatthena'pi pamajjitabbo.

examples.text: upajjhāyamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ. sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo.
kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo.

sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, aruṇ'uggaṃ. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi.

14133.meaning1: name of a householder; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost layman in giving pleasing things; Uggo Vesālika

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho uggo gahapati vesāliko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacce sattā diṭṭh'eva dhamme no parinibbāyanti? ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacce sattā diṭṭh'eva dhamme parinibbāyantī'ti?
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ manāpadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ uggo gahapati vesāliko.

14134.commentary: (ANa) yamako'ti-ādīni tesaṃ nāmāni. tesu hi eko yamako nāma, eko moggallo nāma, eko uggo nāma, eko nāvindakī nāma, eko gandhabbo nāma, eko aggivesso nāma.

examples.text: ime'pi rañño eḷeyyassa parihārakā bālā, yamako moggallo uggo nāvindakī gandhabbo aggivesso, ye samaṇe rāmaputte abhippasannā, samaṇe ca pana rāmaputte evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karonti, yadidaṃ abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikamman'ti.

14135.meaning1: (of the sun) rises; ascends; comes up

examples.text: yato uggacchati sūriyo, ādicco maṇḍalī mahā, yassa c'uggacchamānassa, saṃvarī'pi nirujjhati, yassa c'uggate sūriye, divaso'ti pavuccati.
kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?

14138.meaning1: (of the sun) rising; ascending; coming up

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kūṭ'āgāre vā kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ vā pācīnavātapānā sūriye uggacchante vātapānena rasmi pavisitvā kv'āssa patiṭṭhitā'ti? pacchimāyaṃ, bhante, bhittiyan'ti.
seyyathā'pi vā pan'ānanda, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ sūriye uggacchante, jāneyyāsi tvaṃ, ānanda, andhakāro antaradhāyissati, āloko pātubhavissatī'ti?
yato uggacchati sūriyo, ādicco maṇḍalī mahā, yassa c'uggacchamānassa, saṃvarī'pi nirujjhati, yassa c'uggate sūriye, divaso'ti pavuccati.
atha kho nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa bhagavato sakkāraṃ asahamānassa tatth'eva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggacchī'ti.
atha kho nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa bhagavato sakkāraṃ asahamānassa tatth'eva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggañchi.
yo pana bhikkhu ratanaṃ vā ratanasammataṃ vā aññatra ajjhārāmā vā ajjhāvasathā vā uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
na c'eva lābhī hoti diṭṭh'eva dhamme sukhavihārānaṃ, na lābhī satisampajaññassa. taṃ kissa hetu? tathā hi so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo bhikkhu sakassa cittassa nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
uggaṇhātha, bhikkhave, tāyanagāthā. pariyāpuṇātha, bhikkhave, tāyanagāthā. dhāretha, bhikkhave, tāyanagāthā. atthasaṃhitā, bhikkhave, tāyanagāthā ādibrahmacariyikā'ti.

14150.meaning1: makes pick up; causes to pick up

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu ratanaṃ vā ratanasammataṃ vā aññatra ajjhārāmā vā ajjhāvasathā vā uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yato uggacchati sūriyo, ādicco maṇḍalī mahā, yassa c'uggacchamānassa, saṃvarī'pi nirujjhati, yassa c'uggate sūriye, divaso'ti pavuccati.

14162.meaning1: of high class; of high rank

14163.commentary: (THIa) pīnavaṭṭasahit'uggatā'ti pīnā vaṭṭā aññam'aññaṃ sahitā'va hutvā uggatā uddhamukhā.

examples.text: pīnavaṭṭasahit'uggatā ubho, sobhare su thanakā pure mama, thevikī'va lambanti n'odakā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

14165.meaning1: puffed up with pride; arrogant; haughty
14165.commentary: (ANt) sār'ābhāvena tucchattā naḷo viya naḷo, māno'ti āha unnaḷo'ti uggatanaḷo'ti, uṭṭhitatucchamāno'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sāṭheyyañ'hi abhūtaguṇadassanato abhūtabhaṇḍaguṇadassanasamaṃ katvā kerāṭiyan'ti vuccati. unnaḷā'ti uggatanaḷā, uṭṭhitatucchamānā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

14166.meaning1: of very high class; of very high rank

14167.meaning1: powerful and piercing; of fiery might; blazing hot

examples.text: kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
yo andhakāre tamasi pabhaṅ'karo, verocano maṇḍalī uggatejo. mā rāhu gilī caram'antalikkhe, pajaṃ mamaṃ rāhu pamuñca sūriyan'ti.

14170.meaning1: having risen up; having come up; having emerged (from)

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa mukhato uggantvā paccaggaḷe aṭṭhāsi.

14171.meaning1: son of a noble; high-caste youth
14171.commentary: (SNa) uggaputtā'ti uggatānaṃ puttā mahesakkhā rājaññabhūtā. (THa) asuddhajīvino parivārayuttā manussā uggakiccatāya uggā'ti vuccanti, tesaṃ puttā uggaputtā. (JAa) uggaputtarājaputtiyānan'ti uggatānaṃ amaccaputtānañ'c'eva rājaputtānañ'ca.

examples.text: uggaputtā mah'issāsā, sikkhitā daḷhadhammino, samantā parikireyyuṃ, sahassaṃ apalāyinaṃ.
uggaputta-rājaputtiyānaṃ, urabbhassa maṃsaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ, na sunakhassa te adenti maṃsaṃ, atha meṇḍassa suṇena sakhyam'assa.
taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ hotī'ti ekādase aruṇ'uggamane nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
bhavissanti, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ licchavī sukhumālā mudutalunahatthapādā te mudukāsu seyyāsu tūlabimbohanāsu yāvasūriy'uggamanā seyyaṃ kappissanti.

14176.meaning1: will come up; will emerge; will gush up; will appear suddenly

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bho gotama, sārīrikāya dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭhassa sato ūrukkhambho'pi nāma bhavissati, hadayam'pi nāma phalissati, uṇham'pi lohitaṃ mukhato uggamissati, ummādam'pi pāpuṇissati cittakkhepaṃ.

14178.meaning1: taking up; grasping; embracing; holding (onto); taking a stand (on)

examples.text: ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādayanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
yehi vivitto vicareyya loke, na tāni uggayha vadeyya nāgo, jal'ambujaṃ kaṇḍakaṃ vārijaṃ yathā, jalena paṅkena c'anūpalittaṃ, evaṃ munī santivādo agiddho, kāme ca loke ca anūpalitto.

14181.meaning1: name of a layman; son of a banker in Rājagaha

14183.commentary: (VINa) uggaho nāma kammaṭṭhānassa uggaṇhanaṃ (VINa) evaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ uggaho'ti ettha gārayho ācariy'uggaho na gahetabbo, paveṇiyā āgato ācariy'uggaho'va gahetabbo. kurundiyaṃ pana lokavajje ācariy'uggaho na vaṭṭati, paṇṇattivajje pana vaṭṭatī'ti vuttaṃ. mahāpaccariyaṃ suttaṃ sutt'ānulomañ'ca uggahitakānaṃ'y'eva ācariyānaṃ uggaho pamāṇaṃ, ajānantānaṃ kathā appamāṇan'ti vuttaṃ. taṃ sabbaṃ paveṇiyā āgatesamodhānaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: anāpatti, evaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyānaṃ uggaho paripucchā'ti bhaṇati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

14187.commentary: (SNPa) uggahaṇanti m'aññe'ti uggahaṇanti aññe, aññe tā sammutiyo uggaṇhantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

14189.meaning1: due to study and asking questions
14189.construction:
uggaha + paripucchā + vasa + ena
uggahaparipucchāvasa + ena

examples.text: thero kira avassikakālato paṭṭhāya aṭṭhasamāpattilābhī. so samāpattivikkhambhitānaṃ kilesānaṃ asamudācārena uggahaparipucchāvasen'eva ariyamaggasāmantaṃ katheti, saṭṭhivassakāle'pi attano puthujjanabhāvaṃ na jānāti.
tasmā tesu bhūmibhūtesu dhammesu uggahaparipucchāvasena ñāṇaparicayaṃ katvā mūlabhūtā dve visuddhiyo sampādetvā sarīrabhūtā pañca visuddhiyo sampādentena bhāvetabbā. ayam'ettha saṅkhepo.

14191.meaning2: causes to pick up; makes take or accept; makes learn, teaches

14192.meaning1: having made pick up; having caused to take

examples.text: ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabbaṃ, yassa bhavissati, so harissatī'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

14193.meaning1: picks up; takes up; grasps hold; catches hold (of)

examples.text: purimaṃ pahāya aparaṃ sitāse, ej'ānugā te na taranti saṅgaṃ, te uggahāyanti nirassajanti, kapī'va sākhaṃ pamuñcaṃ gahāyaṃ.
aññātavāde na saṇṭhātī'ti aññātavāde jānitavāde na saṇṭhāti. kathaṃ? ekacco pañhaṃ pucchati, taṃ itaro, manāpo tayā pañho pucchito, kahaṃ te esa uggahito'ti vadati.
aparo pañhaṃ puṭṭho katheti, tam'añño, suṭṭhu te pañho kathito, kattha te uggahito, pañhaṃ kathentena nāma evaṃ kathetabbo'ti vadati.

14197.meaning1: like the time when it was learned

examples.text: yassa pana uggahitaṃ buddhavacanaṃ uggahitakālasadisam'eva hoti, dasa'pi vīsati'pi vassāni sajjhāyaṃ akarontassa na nassati, ayaṃ sutadharo nāma.

14198.meaning2: received formally after being picked up or taken (by oneself
